name: rarefaction
description: Gives the agent an LSP call graph for one symbol before it reads files: signature, body, callers, callees, implementations, tests and impacted files in one call, to save tokens and context.

interface.shortDescription: One symbol's call graph, tests and live files from the language server
interface.longDescription: Rarefaction composes language-server call hierarchy, references, implementations and type hierarchy into one bounded answer about a symbol: its signature and body, callers (with tests picked out), callees, the tests that reach it and the files that can matter. Profiles cover Swift, Rust, C/C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python and WebAssembly text.
defaultPrompt: Orient on the function I'm about to change and tell me which tests reach it.
Who calls this method, and which files would a change to it affect?
